body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target suffers -1 on its next Success Die until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, move 1 unit away from the target.
On a hit, the target also becomes Exposed until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Contingency - Reversal
rider.html: When the target declares an attack against you, you gain +1 to the targeted Defense against that attack.
